# DistortionSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")`

Overdrives the sound until it breaks up, for a megaphone, a blown speaker or an electric guitar.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Level` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | The amount of distortion, from 0 (none) to 1. |
